title: Ocean Scene 7 — Helping at the Reef
purpose: Sequencing, simple inference, and longer who-doing-what descriptions in one connected reef story.

sentenceModels: The clownfish is waiting by the cave.
The crab is carrying a shell.
The octopus is peeking out of the cave.
Two little blue fish are following the turtle.

adultSupport.focus: Talk about what is happening first, what might happen next, and make longer sentences about who is helping at the reef.
starterPrompts: Who is waiting near the cave?
Which animals are following the turtle?
expansionPrompts: What might happen next when the turtle reaches the cave?
Can you make a longer sentence about the clownfish?
Who is helping and who is waiting?

visualAudit: One large turtle swimming toward the cave with seaweed in its mouth.
One orange clownfish waiting beside the rocky cave entrance.
One orange octopus peeking out from the cave.
One red crab on the sand carrying a single shell.
Two small blue fish following the turtle.
